Marine Coordinator

 🚢 Maritime Coordinator | Major Infrastructure Project |

 

Are you an experienced maritime professional with a passion for coordination, safety, and operational excellence?

We are looking for a Maritime Coordinator to support a large-scale infrastructure project in the Antwerp region. In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating vessel movements and maritime operations within a complex construction environment, ensuring safe and efficient interaction between marine traffic and ongoing infrastructure works.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a landmark project where maritime logistics, construction operations, and stakeholder management come together.

 

Your Responsibilities

• Coordinate vessel and marine traffic movements in and around active construction zones.
• Act as the key point of contact between contractors, vessel operators, harbour authorities, pilots, and project teams.
• Ensure maritime activities are planned and executed safely and efficiently.
• Monitor shipping schedules and operational constraints.
• Coordinate marine logistics related to construction activities, transport operations, and project interfaces.
• Identify and mitigate operational risks affecting maritime traffic and project delivery.
• Ensure compliance with maritime regulations, safety procedures, and project requirements.
• Support incident management and emergency response procedures when required.
• Maintain clear communication with internal and external stakeholders.
• Provide operational reports, updates, and recommendations to project management.
 

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Maritime Studies, Nautical Sciences, Logistics, Civil Engineering, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 5+ years of experience in a maritime, port, marine operations, or infrastructure environment.
• Experience coordinating vessel traffic, marine logistics, or harbour operations.
• Knowledge of maritime safety regulations and operational procedures.
• Strong planning and coordination skills.
• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a complex operational environment.
• Fluent Dutch and English required.

FILOform, part of the CRH group, is an innovative solution-focused development and manufacturing company. They focus on smart solutions for connecting, sealing and protecting underground cable, fibre optics and utility networks.

For over 60 years FILOform has broadend their international and domestic network. With their HQ located in the UK and sites in The Netherlands and Germany, their global network is expanding every day. They currently export their products over 30 countries worldwide and provide worldwide support to a wide variety of industries, focusing on Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. 

In order to broaden and complete their sealing portfolio, FILOform has joined forces with Wallmax, resulting in additional innovative solutions for their clients and prospects.

To secure the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax portfolio, within sealing, protection and cable management solutions, we are currently recruiting a Technical Sales Engineer.

Jobomschrijving

You will be accountable for the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax product portfolio within Belgium. You will initiate and implement the local sales strategy securing a solid market share for your region.

• You will step up, maintain, expand and develop long-term relationships with new & existing clients in order to achieve and exceed sales targets.
• You will proactively identify and pursue business opportunities across diverse industries such as Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. By ensuring a close interaction with your key stakeholders you keep abreast on upcoming projects and needs.
• You are able to translate your customer’s challenges into qualitative solutions, ensuring fulfillment of their business needs whilst pursuing customer satisfaction, through dedicated business partnering.
• You will keep abreast of market trends and data, related to the FILOform & Wallmax Product Portfolio and industries, to identify and determine market opportunities, increase the business market share and secure further market penetration.
• You will present business reports, sales reports and forecasts on a monthly basis.
• You will liaise with internal and external stakeholders across all sites, as appropriate.
• You will be updating the CRM tools (Salesforce, …).
• You will report directly to the Sales Manager BENE with who you will have close interactions and regular meetings.

• Bachelor or Master background combined with a senior technical sales experience with a proven track record and client portfolio within the Energy, Infrastructure, Data or Telecom sector. 
• Demonstrated history of achieving sales targets, growing revenue, analyzing and following-up on KPI’s.
• Able to quickly master and understand all technical aspects of the business and flexible towards new product introductions.
• Able to manage long and complex commercial- and product approval processes.
• Used to work in an innovative environment with a strong international and customer-oriented mindset.
• Reliable and valuable business partner assuring strong stakeholder management.
• Strong analytical skillset with the ability to effectively analyze market trends and customer needs.
• Experience in tender management is a plus.
• You are based in Belgium and are flexible to travel across the country to visit clients.
• Flexible to travel to The Netherlands and/or UK when required (limited).
• This role is a stand alone role that is mainly managed from a Home Office setting.
• You are fluent in English, Dutch and French.

jobs.occupation: Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development
jobs.description:
Our client is an international, fast-growing organization operating in a highly dynamic and data-driven B2B environment. As part of a leading European group, the Belgian organization combines entrepreneurial agility with the structure and support of an international matrix organization. To support its continued growth and further strengthen its customer-facing operations, our client is looking for a Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development, you will play a pivotal leadership role within the Belgian organization. You will be responsible for leading a team of 30-35 Inside Sales & Customer Advisors across multiple locations, ensuring operational excellence, commercial performance and an outstanding customer experience. 

Working closely with both the Belgian leadership team and international stakeholders, you will translate strategic objectives into clear deliverables driving accountability and ownership. 

• Build a high-performing organisation by developing talent, empowering Team Leads and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. 
• Establish clear performance frameworks, monitor business-critical KPIs and proactively steer the organisation towards ambitious commercial and operational objectives. 
• Continuously evaluate and optimise workflows, sales processes and customer interactions to improve efficiency, quality and overall business performance. 
• Leverage data, reporting and digital tools to identify trends, generate actionable insights and support informed decision-making. 
• Act as the driving force behind operational change, successfully embedding new initiatives, technologies and best practices across the organisation. 
• Build trusted relationships with key internal stakeholders, ensuring strong cross functional collaboration and alignment within an international matrix environment. 
• Champion a customer-centric mindset by balancing commercial ambition with service excellence and long-term customer value. 
• Play an active role within the Belgian Management Team, contributing to the company's strategic direction and supporting its continued growth. 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, providing a strong foundation for a commercial leadership role. 
• Proven track record managing larger inside sales, contact centre or customer service teams within a B2B environment preferably within an international and/or matrix driven organisation. 
• Extensive people management experience and know how to coach teams towards performance and accountability. 
• Strong analytical mindset combined with experience managing performance through KPIs, reporting and data analysis. 
• Demonstrated experience improving operational processes and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different organizational levels. 
• Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment where adaptability and resilience are essential. 
• Affinity with digital transformation, AI tools and process automation is considered a plus. 
• Fluency in Dutch, French and English are required.

S-Biomedic, where your work truly makes a difference! 
 
 

At S-Biomedic, we are passionate about cutting-edge microbiome science. We are looking for a 
Project Associate – Development to join our team. You will be operating at the intersection of research, development, and manufacturing and we offer a unique opportunity to work closely with experts across multiple disciplines within our company.
 

Your responsibilities?
 

- Project Coordination & Execution:
 
 

• Support project planning, timeline tracking, and milestone management. 

• Coordinate activities across R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, and external partners. 

• Maintain project plans, action trackers, risk registers, and project documentation. 

• Prepare project status reports, meeting minutes, and presentation materials. 

• Follow up on project deliverables and ensure alignment with agreed timelines.

• Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support decision-making.

Your qualifications?
 

- Technical competencies & IT competencies:
 
 

• Basic understanding of project management principles and tools within development, manufacturing, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, or other regulated environments. 

• Ability to support the preparation and maintenance of project plans, timelines, milestones, action trackers, and project documentation. 

• Experience coordinating tasks across multiple stakeholders and facilitating communication between internal teams and external partners. 

• Ability to collect, consolidate, and report project information to support project monitoring and decision-making. 

• Understanding of project risks and issues, with the ability to identify, document, and escalate concerns appropriately. 

• Experience preparing meeting minutes, action logs, project reports, and presentation materials. 

• Familiarity with coordinating materials, samples, inventory, or logistics-related activities to support project execution. 

• Ability to organize and visualize project data using spreadsheets, dashboards, or reporting tools. 

• Basic understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), documentation practices, and compliance requirements in regulated environments. 

• Ability to support the preparation, review, and maintenance of technical and quality documentation. 

• Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accurate record keeping. 

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams. 

• Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, Monday.com, or equivalent. 

• Ability to create basic dashboards, reports, and project trackers. 

- Fluent in English.
 

- Experience: 2+ years of experience in Project Coordination, Project Management Support, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, Product Development, or a related role within Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Cosmetics, FMCG, or other technical environments.
 

- Eduation:
 
 

• Bachelor’s /Masters degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related technical or scientific discipline. 

• Formal training or certification in Project Management (e.g. PRINCE2 Foundation/Practitioner, PMP, CAPM, Agile or equivalent) is a plus.

Are you organized, customer-oriented, and ready for a new challenge in international logistics?

As an Air Import Agent, you play a crucial role in coordinating export processes and providing excellent customer service. Read on and discover what your future could look like in our dynamic team!

Jobomschrijving

As an Air Import Agent, you are responsible for smoothly and timely coordinating air freight and providing excellent customer service. You ensure that everything, from freight transportation to administrative processing, runs seamlessly.

As an Air Import Agent, you engage in the following activities:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow.
• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system.
• Track and trace Air Import files as required. This can be either internally via exp.o or externally via airline websites or by telephone to
airline offices.
• Use Tree View on daily basis.
• Ensure timely delivery of freight to customers for Import shipments.
• Ensure documents are timely sent to customer or broker for customs purposes.
• Ensure accurate and timely client and vendors billing.
• Interact with our customers in arranging their international shipments, meeting customer service standards.
• Contribute to maintain strong relationships with vendors (airlines, trucking companies, and others).
• Meet compliance at all times to regulations. 
• Understand department process flow, constantly looking for areas of improved efficiency.
• Ensure all customers standard operating procedures are followed and updated in the DLSOP.
• Overseas communications, timely responses to emails and requests (internal and external)
• Meets company standards of 52 hours training per year per employee.
• Promote compliance in diligently following all company policies and regulations and performing the task at hand with outstanding
integrity and pride.

The Air Import Agent we're looking for:

• 2- 3 years of experience withing air freight (import specifically)
• Proactive attitude and well-developed organizational skills.
• Good knowledge of Excel and Word; experience in air freight/logistics is a plus.
• Very good knowledge of English AND Dutch
• IATA certification is a plus.
• A positive mindset, problem-solving ability, and a good sense of humor.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst
jobs.description:
As a vehicle technician, you are responsible for the maintenance and repair of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles of all makes. You will work in a spacious, modern body shop known for its craftsmanship and customer focus. The workshop specializes in both conventional and electric/hybrid vehicles, so you'll work with the latest automotive technologies.

On a typical day, you’ll independently carry out both minor and major maintenance services. You diagnose technical issues using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and perform mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs. Quality is key, and you ensure every vehicle leaves the workshop in top condition.

Are you a precise, self-reliant technician with a passion for cars? Apply now and become part of a dedicated team. Together, you’ll ensure satisfied customers and vehicles in perfect working order.

• Diploma in automotive technology at secondary education level or equivalent through experience

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a car technician

• Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and systems

• Able to work independently and accurately

• Proficient in English, both spoken and written

• Holder of a valid category B driver’s license

• Passion for vehicles and new technologies

Step into an exciting role as a Folding Machine Operator - this is your chance to work with a team committed to crafting the future of the printing industry, leveraging cutting-edge technology and a no-nonsense approach.Your day will involve setting up and operating folding machines like the Heidelberg Stahlfolder, ensuring that all materials meet quality standards. You’ll perform regular maintenance and minor repairs, keeping your workspace organized and efficient. Collaboration is key, so you’ll hand over tasks smoothly to your colleagues to maintain seamless production.Ready to make your mark in a future-focused company? Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with ample opportunities for growth and development.

• Strong technical insight, preferably with a technical degree

• Ability to work independently and with precision

• Hands-on attitude, ready to assist wherever needed

• Flexibility to switch machines or work overtime when necessary

• At least 5 years of experience as a folding operator in a printing company

• Experience with perfect binding is a plus

• Proficient in English

Dive into a dynamic role where your skills in mechanical assembly will keep everything in its rightful place. As a Pre-Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the meticulous assembly and disassembly of tooling on our state-of-the-art roll forming lines. Your day will involve transporting and maintaining tooling, ensuring a clean and safe workspace, and reporting any repairs or improvements needed. If you thrive in a detail-oriented environment and are eager to learn, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

A typical day sees you inspecting your own work for precision, collaborating with team members, and operating both conventional and CNC-controlled machines. You’ll ensure that every piece meets our high standards of quality and accuracy. This role requires independent work, flexibility, and a keen eye for detail, making sure every component fits perfectly.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

• Education in mechanics or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Eagerness to learn, conscientiousness, and sense of responsibility

• Ability to work independently and safely

• Flexibility and willingness to work in a 2-shift system

• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, order, and cleanliness

• Technical background or equivalent experience

As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be crucial in keeping our advanced machinery running smoothly in the fruit and vegetable food industry. Your role involves handling maintenance tasks and optimizing equipment like flowpackers and labeling machines, ensuring peak efficiency in our production line.

On a typical day, you'll troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform minor repairs, and maintain building systems such as fire alarms. You'll coordinate with suppliers for any complex repairs, ensuring everything runs seamlessly.

• Experience as an all-round maintenance and repair technician
• Experience in the food industry is a plus
• Proficiency in both mechanics and electronics
• Good command of English
• Familiarity with various PC programs

As a Truck Driver CE, you are responsible for transporting goods within Belgium, Northern France, and Southern Netherlands. You load and unload the truck yourself with an electric pallet truck and always check your documents and vehicle. You register everything correctly in the onboard computer. Ready to hit the road independently? Apply now!

• You have a CE driving license and a valid professional competence certificate (code 95).

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Truck Driver CE.

• You speak fluent Dutch or English.

• You can work independently and are accurate with administration.

• You are comfortable with a PC and onboard computer.

• You are willing to work an average of 12 hours per day.

• You live within commuting distance to Hooglede.

As an operator, together with a colleague, you are responsible for operating and setting up the production line. You use an overhead crane, set the correct parameters and knife distances, and make sure the rolls are properly packaged. Some administrative work on the computer is also part of your job. You work in two fixed shifts: from 5 a.m. to 1 p.m. or from 1 p.m. to 9 p.m.
Every day is varied: setting up machines, performing quality checks, and processing production documentation. You are alert to safety and contribute to a smooth production process.
Does this job appeal to you? Apply now!

• Relevant experience as an operator

• Technical insight and logical thinking

• Good computer skills

• Attention to quality and safety

• Stress-resistant and result-oriented

• Team player

• You speak fluent Dutch or English

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.

• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.

• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.

• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.

• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.

• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.

• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.

• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.

• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).

• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.

• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.

• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you a real night owl and do you enjoy an active, hands-on job? Then we may have the perfect job for you! We are looking for a motivated Warehouse Operator to join the permanent night shift. You will work for a stable and growing company where you can count on proper training, a great team atmosphere and an attractive salary package. Your responsibilities As a Warehouse Operator, you play an important role in the logistics process. You make sure that goods are processed correctly and that orders are ready for shipment. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods
 
• Picking orders using voice picking and/or scanning
 
• Preparing orders accurately and on time for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Moving goods using an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck
 
• Keeping the warehouse clean, organised and safe
 
• Following safety, hygiene and quality procedures (HACCP)
 
• Working in a chilled environment, including a freezer area 

Who are we looking for? You don't need years of experience for this position. Motivation and the right attitude are just as important! We are looking for someone who:
 

 
• Preferably has experience as a warehouse operator, although motivated candidates without experience are also welcome
 
• Works accurately and responsibly
 
• Is not afraid of physical work and enjoys being hands-on
 
• Can work independently as well as in a team
 
• Speaks and understands Dutch and/or English
 
• Has experience with an electric pallet truck or reach truck (a valid certificate is a plus)
 
• Is comfortable working in a cold/freezer environment
 
• Is willing to work the permanent night shift
